title: Learning Loop V2 program authority and controlled parallel execution
purpose: Deliver one complete local-first learning loop with explicit objectives, training, corrective review, distinct validation, per-objective progress and reliable desktop/Android resume, using four disjoint development lanes, independent QA and a non-repairing integrator.

programDecision.humanGate: one complete product candidate on desktop and Android

waveA.objective: Produce a complete minimal vertical slice on one representative kit: objectives visible, training result recorded, corrective review usable, distinct validation evaluated, per-objective progress persisted and resume preserved.
waveA.contractDecision: Use the existing learnit.kit.v2 objectiveIds, learningPhase and assessmentRole fields. No JSON Schema change is authorized in Wave A.
waveA.storageDecision: Only additive Learn-it Next state may be introduced. No mutation or reuse of protected RC718 storage and no destructive migration.
acceptanceScenarios: Import a representative existing v2 kit and display its authored objectives.
Submit an incorrect training activity and retain normal course progress.
Enter the corrective review queue, correct the activity and remove it from the queue.
Complete a distinct validation activity for the same objective.
Display separate per-objective training, review-needed and validation states without claiming durable mastery.
Close and reopen the application and preserve course, review and objective-progress state.
Produce one exact tested HTML artifact for desktop and Android human validation.

sharedInterfaces.claimBoundary: validated-recently is a product-state label only; it is not a claim of mastery, retention or certification.

DEV-LEARNING.mission: Implement pure objective-progress and recommendation logic behind stable data-only interfaces.

DEV-UX.mission: Implement objective and recommendation presentation as isolated UI helpers and styles.

DEV-AUTHORING.mission: Strengthen authoring validation and representative kits using the existing frozen v2 contract.

DEV-PLATFORM.mission: Compose the domain and UI interfaces into session, progress, persistence and runtime behavior without changing the frozen contract.

independentQa.mission: Prepare and execute contradictory end-to-end behavior tests against integrated candidates without modifying product files.

integration.mission: Assemble exact accepted lane heads, reconcile build inputs and run the complete matrix without silently repairing lane-owned files.
integration.promotionGate: Wave B complete product candidate after independent QA and human validation

invariants: The four development lanes have no overlapping owned file path.
The frozen learnit.kit.v2 JSON Schema is not modified in Wave A.
An integrator never silently repairs a lane-owned product file.
Developer tests and independent QA tests are separate files.
No mastery, retention, certification or durable-learning claim is introduced.
Completed activity semantics, QCM/fill behavior, accessibility, import and P1 corrective review remain non-regressive.
Every integrated candidate builds deterministically and publishes the exact HTML bytes that were tested.
No autonomous merge, direct write to main or release publication is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Each lane is based on the exact authorized baseline and changes only its allowlist.
Each lane passes its fixed Learn-it Next profile and developer tests.
The integrator proves exact accepted lane heads and no undeclared path overlap.
Independent QA executes against the exact integrated candidate.
Two clean builds are byte-for-byte identical.
The exact tested HTML artifact is downloadable.
Desktop and Android human validation pass before promotion.
adversarialTests: Reject a lane patch that touches a shared composition path it does not own.
Reject a contract or schema change in Wave A.
Reject objective progress inferred from display-only events.
Reject validation credit from a training activity.
Reject a corrected training item being reported as durable mastery.
Reject destructive storage migration or protected RC718 namespace reuse.
Reject integrated candidates whose manifest or artifact does not match the accepted lane heads.
independentReview: Issue #119 remains the single program authority.
QA remains independent from all four development lanes.
Governor review is required only for contract changes, scope changes, product-candidate acceptance and promotion.
rollback: Revert the integrated Learning Loop V2 candidate. Existing P1 product behavior, frozen contract, protected RC718 storage, bootstrap tools and accepted snapshot evidence remain available.
